title: Hi-Light Japan R6 titanium road frame
notes: Current official Japanese distributor page specifies 3Al–2.5V titanium, an approximate 1,500 g frame weight in size L, 35C clearance, BSA, five stock sizes plus custom sizing and the R6 conventional-tube routing detail. It is frame evidence, not evidence for the China R6 105 AL complete-build drivetrain or total weight.
